- We see 12 distinct org identifiers from Nebula that have requested grant increases in the last 10 days; 9 of those were created within the same 48-hour window.
- IP/TLS fingerprints show requests originating from a narrow set of outbound proxies, and the user agent pattern matches the company's CI automation naming convention.
- One of the ephemeral accounts attempted a second grant request and used three different email aliases within 6 hours.

I attached a short CSV with request ids and timestamps. Recommendation: pause automated grant approvals for this account and open a manual validation with the customer.
